<!-- A REFERENCE READ, one for each site a design language learned from. It is kept beside the language's construct, and the construct's
     References table points at it. The read is of one site, on one day, at one viewport, and it never copies the site's words, pictures
     or branding. Each subsection is read into the same five parts and the same ids as the language, so an agent compares a site with
     the language part by part. A status is MAPPED where the design system holds the choice, GAP where it does not yet, and NOT_TAKEN
     where the language leaves the technique out. -->
